name: How long does a typical roof maintenance assessment take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical roof maintenance assessment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard roof maintenance assessment typically takes about 30 to 60 minutes, depending on the size and complexity of your roof. Larger or multi-level roofs, or those with extensive damage, may require more time for a comprehensive inspection. The assessment includes both exterior roof examination and often an interior check of the attic space. To help streamline the process, ensure your property is easily accessible and that any pets are secured during the scheduled time.
